ounce Leap takes you on a thrilling adventure through a series of challenging levels that will test your reflexes and strategic thinking. As the player, you are in control of a character who continuously moves forward on a platform. Your mission is to navigate through the dynamic environment, collecting balls that match your character's color to increase its size and score points.

Timing and precision are crucial as you encounter various obstacles and balls of different colors along the way. It's essential to avoid balls that don't match your character's color, as colliding with them will cause your character to shrink and potentially lead to a game over.
